response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall_avg GROUP BY g.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is the mean over all linked signal rows (after the inner joins), not the mean of the group averages.
Per-weather-profile figures are unweighted means of the qualifying telescope/weather group averages (each group counts once, regardless of signal count).
Signals with a NULL modindex or phaseshiftdeg are ignored by AVG. Groups whose weathprofile is NULL form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the telescope/weather group averages (each group weighted equally) instead of the mean over all signals.
